title: The Courage to Do the Right Thing
coreMove: Choose the costly right action that sends burden toward you instead of down the chain.
sourcePressure: Turns leadership into cost: courage is accepting discomfort or risk so people, truth, and standards are not abandoned under pressure.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating courage as personal boldness, dramatic confrontation, or risk for its own sake.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary
